# v0.18.17 named Run Profile timing presets

Saved timing presets are Controller preferences only: a bounded library of
names and seconds outside the Universal configuration and compiled Plan.
Applying one selects the existing Custom Run Profile. Never bind runtime
authority to a mutable preset name/id or resolve a saved preset during Resume.
Start freezes the actual normalized seconds in its existing Plan; preset edits,
selection or deletion must not change an active/resumable batch. Preserve the
library across reset and atomic state updates. AUTO still disables Relay.

For a new Telegram RUN after a completed batch, confirmation binds the actual
editable draft configuration and compiled hash that Start will use. Active or
resumable batches continue binding their frozen Plan. Never confirm old timing
while executing a different draft, or use library metadata as runtime authority.

The Relay final native-input guard must recheck Controller/Plan and watchdog
authority after the final window/Geometry validation, then check witness age,
under the same runtime mutex. A deadline that wins during validation prevents
input without clearing the pending intent or replenishing any budget.

# Axiom Vision v0.18.17 — Run Profile Presets

บันทึกชื่อและเวลาของ Run Profile สำหรับแต่ละการฟาร์มได้
รายการ PRESET อยู่ใต้ RUN PROFILE และก่อน RANDOM BOOST

- SAVE AS สร้าง Preset โดยตั้งชื่อและเวลา 30–1,800 วินาที
- เลือก Preset เพื่อใช้เวลาที่บันทึกไว้เป็น Custom
- EDIT แก้ชื่อหรือเวลา และ DELETE ลบรายการที่เลือก
- รองรับชื่อภาษาไทยและเก็บไว้หลังปิดโปรแกรมหรือ Reset Batch
- บันทึกทันที ไม่ต้องเริ่มแบตช์ก่อน และไม่เปลี่ยน Random Boost, Relay หรือจำนวนรอบ
- ระหว่างที่แบตช์ยังแก้การตั้งค่าไม่ได้ ปุ่ม Preset จะถูกล็อกด้วย
  Resume ใช้แผนและเวลาที่ตรึงไว้ตอนเริ่ม ไม่อ่านค่าจาก Preset ที่อาจแก้ภายหลัง

AUTO / SHORT / NORMAL / CUSTOM ยังใช้ได้ตามเดิม
AUTO ใช้ Cookie Relay ไม่ได้ เมื่อเปิด Relay เวลาของ Preset คือเวลาประมาณของ
Cookie ตัวแรก ระบบใช้เวลานี้ช่วยเริ่มเฝ้าภาพ ไม่ใช้เวลาเป็นหลักฐานว่าปุ่มปรากฏ
หรือว่าวิ่งจบแล้ว ต้องยืนยันปุ่ม Relay จากภาพสดก่อนส่งคลิก

แก้การตรวจสิทธิ์ Relay รอบสุดท้าย: ถ้า watchdog หมดเวลาระหว่างตรวจหน้าต่าง
จะไม่ส่งคลิก และยังเก็บ intent ไว้ตามกฎไม่กดซ้ำ

แก้ข้อความยืนยัน RUN ทาง Telegram หลังแบตช์เดิมจบ ให้แสดง Run Profile
และผูกกับค่าที่เลือกสำหรับงานใหม่ การเปลี่ยนเวลาทำให้คำยืนยันเก่าใช้ไม่ได้
ส่วน Resume ยังผูกกับแผนเดิมที่ตรึงไว้
ช่อง Custom ปฏิเสธค่าที่ไม่ใช่จำนวนเต็มหรืออยู่นอกช่วง แทนการแปลงเป็น AUTO เงียบ ๆ

Stop / Pause / Human Verification และกฎภาพสด หน้าต่าง Geometry และ replay
ยังทำงานตามเดิม ไม่เปลี่ยนสิทธิ์ Heart Sender และระบบอ่านสมบัติยังปิดอยู่
Universal Mission ใช้ revision 9 เมื่อ Relay OFF และ revision 10 เมื่อ Relay ON

อัปเดตที่ Settings → CHECK UPDATE รอช่วงที่ updater ติดตั้งได้
ไฟล์ state / checkpoint / stats / session เดิมคงอยู่ ไม่ต้อง Reset Batch เพื่ออัปเดต

ตรวจ UI และเส้นทางจำลองบน Linux การกด Relay ทันหน้าต่าง 2 วินาที
และผลในเกมยังไม่ได้ยืนยันบน Windows / LDPlayer จริง

# Design System: Run Profile Time Presets

## Overview

Only the Command Center timing extension is covered. The incumbent black/gold Operate world is preserved. Authority: `scripts/visionstudio_controller.py`. The scoped sidecar illustrates Tk controls in HTML; it is not the native implementation.

## Colors

Gold identifies selection, action outlines, focus and the dialog save action. Muted text labels rows/instructions; raised/alternate surfaces separate controls. Errors are red. Disabled controls are subdued; selected locked profile chips retain gold text and an outline.

## Typography

Declared families are Segoe UI and Segoe UI Semibold. Positive Tk font sizes are points; Canvas dimensions/spacing are pixels. Entry/OptionMenu widths are character units. Host font substitution changes geometry.

## Layout

Order: Batch Target → Run Profile → **Time Preset** → Random Boost → Cookie Relay → Telegram Summary → geometry → actions. Presets follow Run Profile by 6px. Label width 11, trailing gap 9px; menu width 27, trailing gap 7px. SAVE AS / EDIT / DELETE: 76/58/68px wide, 30px high, 5px gaps. Existing AUTO / SHORT / NORMAL / CUSTOM chips: 56/60/68/70px wide, 34px high.

The non-resizable transient dialog centers over its parent, with 22px horizontal/20px vertical padding. Fields: width 32, inner vertical padding 7px. CANCEL / SAVE PRESET: 88/118px wide, 34px high, 8px gap. No mobile layout is established.

## Elevation & Depth

Flat tonal layering and one-pixel outlines; no added shadows or animation. The dialog uses a native Toplevel window.

## Shapes

Rectangular controls/panels. RoundedButton draws square rectangles. Focused actions use a two-pixel outline. Fields use flat relief and a one-pixel highlight, gold on focus.

## Components

- **Menu:** entries show name, separator and seconds suffixed `s`. Empty: “No saved times — use SAVE AS”; menu, EDIT and DELETE disable. SAVE AS remains available for editable configuration.
- **Selection:** choosing a saved time selects CUSTOM and fills seconds. SAVE AS creates; EDIT updates the selected entry. Saves and selection persist immediately in Controller preferences and survive reopen/reset. Manual profile/time changes clear the saved association. DELETE confirms, removes the entry and leaves the current timing unchanged.
- **Dialog:** name plus 30–1,800 whole seconds. Errors stay inline in red; success closes. Enter saves, Escape cancels; name receives focus. Names: 1–48 characters, normalized and unique ignoring case; maximum 50 presets.
- **Authority:** preset actions lock with active configuration; delayed actions recheck authority. Resume retains the frozen Plan. A saved name labels the profile only when its Custom duration matches. Timing selection does not choose Boost, Relay or loop count; AUTO forces Relay OFF.

## Do's and Don'ts

- **Do** retain native controls, compact alignment and gold selection language.
- **Do** keep this document scoped to timing presets.
- **Don't** treat a preset name as Mission or active Plan authority.
- **Don't** infer Windows rendering from Linux evidence. Four Tk captures cover empty, dialog, selected/reopened and active/locked at 1280×820, 1280×900 and 1440×1000. Thai persistence was checked; the host lacked a Thai font, so Thai glyph rendering was not verified. Windows/LDPlayer were not exercised.

from __future__ import annotations

import copy
from pathlib import Path
import sys
import tempfile
import unittest
from unittest import mock

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / "scripts"))
import visionstudio_controller as ui
import visionstudio_controller_state as state
import visionstudio_universal_mission as universal


class Variable:
    def __init__(self, value): self.value = value
    def get(self): return self.value
    def set(self, value): self.value = value


class HeadlessController(ui.VisionStudioController):
    @property
    def control_path(self): return self.test_control_path


class ControllerRunProfilePresetTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.directory = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
        self.addCleanup(self.directory.cleanup)
        self.path = Path(self.directory.name) / "controller" / "state.json"
        self.app = self.make_app()

    def make_app(self):
        app = object.__new__(HeadlessController)
        app.test_control_path = self.path
        app.mission_var = Variable(str(universal.UNIVERSAL_MISSION_IDENTITY_PATH))
        app.run_profile_mode = Variable("auto")
        app.custom_run_seconds = Variable("240")
        app.cookie_relay_mode = Variable("off")
        app.cookie_relay_chips = [mock.Mock(), mock.Mock()]
        app.cookie_relay_hint = Variable("")
        app.profile_summary = Variable("")
        app.random_boost_mode = Variable("targeted")
        app.random_boost_target = Variable("Double Coins")
        app.telegram_enabled = Variable(True)
        app.custom_run_seconds_entry = mock.Mock()
        app.run_profile_preset_menu = mock.MagicMock()
        app.run_profile_preset_choice = Variable("")
        app.run_profile_preset_save_button = mock.Mock()
        app.run_profile_preset_edit_button = mock.Mock()
        app.run_profile_preset_delete_button = mock.Mock()
        app.run_profile_presets = []
        app.selected_run_profile_preset_id = None
        app._applying_run_profile_preset = False
        app.configuration_enabled = True
        app._stats = lambda: ({}, {})
        app._worker_active = lambda: False
        app._heart_conflict_for_universal = lambda: None
        app._latest_frame_path = lambda: None
        app._requested_loops = lambda: 10
        app._validate_ready = lambda: universal.compile_universal_mission(app._universal_config()).mission
        app._launch_worker = mock.Mock()
        app._retire_open_review_verification = mock.Mock()
        return app

    def save(self, name="ฟาร์ม EXP", seconds="150"):
        result = self.app._save_run_profile_preset_values(name=name, seconds=seconds)
        self.assertTrue(result.ok, result.detail)
        return self.app.selected_run_profile_preset_id

    def start(self, profile="short"):
        return state.request_start(
            self.path, mission_path=universal.UNIVERSAL_MISSION_IDENTITY_PATH,
            requested_loops=10, run_until=None, telegram_enabled=True,
            run_profile={"mode": profile, "expected_seconds": 150 if profile == "custom" else None},
        )

    def test_saved_time_is_immediate_and_reopen_restores_custom_draft(self):
        preset_id = self.save()
        restored = state.read_state(self.path)
        self.assertEqual(restored["selected_run_profile_preset_id"], preset_id)
        self.assertEqual(restored["run_profile"], {"mode": "auto", "expected_seconds": None})
        self.assertIsNone(restored["batch_plan"])
        reopened = self.make_app()
        reopened._restore_run_profile_preset_selection(restored)
        self.assertEqual(reopened._run_profile(), {"mode": "custom", "expected_seconds": 150})
        self.assertIn("ฟาร์ม EXP", reopened.run_profile_preset_choice.get())

    def test_selecting_time_preserves_boost_relay_and_loop_preferences(self):
        first = self.save()
        self.save("ฟาร์มเหรียญ", "270")
        self.app.cookie_relay_mode.set("on")
        self.app.random_boost_mode.set("off")
        result = self.app._choose_run_profile_preset(first)
        self.assertTrue(result.ok)
        config = self.app._universal_config()
        self.assertEqual(config["run_profile"]["expected_seconds"], 150)
        self.assertEqual(config["random_boost"]["mode"], "off")
        self.assertEqual(config["cookie_relay"], {"enabled": True})
        self.assertEqual(config["requested_loops"], 10)

    def test_manual_profile_or_time_change_clears_saved_selection(self):
        for change in ("chip", "time"):
            with self.subTest(change=change):
                if change == "chip":
                    self.save("EXP chip")
                    self.app.cookie_relay_mode.set("on")
                    self.app.run_profile_mode.set("auto")
                    self.app._manual_run_profile_changed()
                    self.assertEqual(self.app.cookie_relay_mode.get(), "off")
                else:
                    self.save("EXP time")
                    self.app.custom_run_seconds.set("165")
                    self.app._custom_run_seconds_changed()
                self.assertIsNone(state.read_state(self.path)["selected_run_profile_preset_id"])
                self.assertEqual(self.app.run_profile_preset_choice.get(), "Choose a saved time")

    def test_delete_selected_keeps_current_seconds_and_reopen_does_not_resurrect_it(self):
        self.save()
        with mock.patch.object(ui.messagebox, "askyesno", return_value=True):
            self.app._delete_selected_run_profile_preset()
        self.assertEqual(self.app._run_profile()["expected_seconds"], 150)
        document = state.read_state(self.path)
        self.assertEqual(document["run_profile_presets"], [])
        self.assertIsNone(document["selected_run_profile_preset_id"])
        reopened = self.make_app()
        reopened._restore_run_profile_preset_selection(document)
        self.assertEqual(reopened.run_profile_mode.get(), "auto")

    def test_deleted_menu_id_is_rejected_without_applying_old_time(self):
        preset_id = self.save()
        state.delete_run_profile_preset(self.path, preset_id)
        self.app.custom_run_seconds.set("165")
        with mock.patch.object(ui.messagebox, "showerror") as error:
            result = self.app._choose_run_profile_preset(preset_id)
        self.assertFalse(result.ok)
        self.assertEqual(self.app.custom_run_seconds.get(), "165")
        error.assert_called_once()

    def test_duplicate_name_and_invalid_time_return_recoverable_errors(self):
        self.save("Farm EXP")
        before = self.path.read_bytes()
        duplicate = self.app._save_run_profile_preset_values(name=" farm exp ", seconds="165")
        self.assertFalse(duplicate.ok)
        for bad in ("", "150.9", "NaN", "29", "1801", True, 150.5, "9" * 5000):
            with self.subTest(seconds=str(bad)[:20]):
                result = self.app._save_run_profile_preset_values(name="Other", seconds=bad)
                self.assertFalse(result.ok)
        self.assertEqual(self.path.read_bytes(), before)

    def test_active_state_rechecks_delayed_save_select_and_delete_callbacks(self):
        preset_id = self.save()
        started = self.start()
        frozen = copy.deepcopy(started["batch_plan"])
        before = self.path.read_bytes()
        self.assertFalse(self.app._save_run_profile_preset_values(name="Too late", seconds="165").ok)
        self.assertFalse(self.app._choose_run_profile_preset(preset_id).ok)
        with mock.patch.object(ui.messagebox, "askyesno") as ask:
            self.app._delete_selected_run_profile_preset()
        ask.assert_not_called()
        self.assertEqual(self.path.read_bytes(), before)
        self.assertEqual(state.read_state(self.path)["batch_plan"], frozen)

    def test_delete_confirmation_rechecks_worker_transition(self):
        self.save()
        def start_during_confirmation(*_args, **_kwargs):
            self.start()
            return True
        with mock.patch.object(ui.messagebox, "askyesno", side_effect=start_during_confirmation):
            self.app._delete_selected_run_profile_preset()
        self.assertEqual(len(state.read_state(self.path)["run_profile_presets"]), 1)

    def test_active_or_resumable_restore_keeps_frozen_ui_and_plan(self):
        self.save()
        started = self.start()
        for desired, resumable in (("running", False), ("stopped", True)):
            with self.subTest(desired=desired):

                self.assertEqual(state.read_state(self.path)["batch_plan"], started["batch_plan"])

    def test_stopped_resumable_draft_selection_does_not_mutate_resume_plan(self):
        preset_id = self.save()

        self.assertEqual(state.read_state(self.path)["batch_plan"], started["batch_plan"])

    def test_invalid_custom_text_keeps_ui_live_and_blocks_start_without_truncation(self):
        self.app.run_profile_mode.set("custom")
        self.app.cookie_relay_mode.set("on")
        for value in ("", "150.9", "abc", "29", "1801"):
            with self.subTest(value=value):

    def test_locking_row_disables_all_preset_controls(self):

        for button in (self.app.run_profile_preset_save_button, self.app.run_profile_preset_edit_button, self.app.run_profile_preset_delete_button):
            button.set_enabled.assert_called_with(False)

    def test_completed_batch_remote_run_binds_current_timing_and_changes_with_ui(self):
        started = self.start()
        batch = dict(started["batch_plan"], status="completed", completed_loops=10)
        state.patch_state(self.path, desired_state="completed", worker={"status": "completed"}, batch_plan=batch)
        self.app.run_profile_mode.set("custom")

"""Regression coverage for private Relay input deadline boundaries."""
from pathlib import Path
import tempfile
import unittest
from unittest import mock

import test_cookie_relay_runtime as relay_tests


class CookieRelayFinalGuardTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_stage_deadline_during_final_controller_read_blocks_dispatch(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as temporary:
            server, session, desktop, window, image, _proof, state = (
                relay_tests.CookieRelayRuntimeTests.fixture(self, Path(temporary))
            )
            now = [1000.9]
            session.current_stage_started_monotonic = 1000.0
            session.current_stage_timeout_seconds = 1
            reads = [0]

            def controller_read(_session):
                reads[0] += 1
                if reads[0] == 3:
                    now[0] = 1001.1
                return state

            server._controller_gate.side_effect = controller_read
            with mock.patch.object(relay_tests.bridge.time, "monotonic", side_effect=lambda: now[0]):
                self.assertFalse(server._try_cookie_relay(session, window, image, now[0]))
            self.assertEqual(reads[0], 3)
            self.assertFalse(desktop.clicks)
            self.assertTrue(session.resume_required)
            self.assertEqual(session.cookie_relay_state["status"], "pending")
            self.assertEqual(session.cookie_relay_state["attempts"], 1)

    def test_stage_deadline_during_last_window_check_blocks_dispatch(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as temporary:
            server, session, desktop, window, image, _proof, _state = (
                relay_tests.CookieRelayRuntimeTests.fixture(self, Path(temporary))
            )
            now = [1000.9]
            session.current_stage_started_monotonic = 1000.0
            session.current_stage_timeout_seconds = 1
            checks = [0]

            def window_check(_session):
                checks[0] += 1
                if checks[0] == 3:
                    # Foreground acquisition can cross the Stage deadline even
                    # while the final image is under its 0.5-second age budget.
                    now[0] = 1001.1
                return window

            server._verified_action_window.side_effect = window_check
            with mock.patch.object(relay_tests.bridge.time, "monotonic", side_effect=lambda: now[0]):
                self.assertFalse(server._try_cookie_relay(session, window, image, now[0]))
            self.assertEqual(checks[0], 3)
            self.assertFalse(desktop.clicks)
            self.assertTrue(session.resume_required)
            self.assertEqual(session.cookie_relay_state["status"], "pending")
            self.assertEqual(session.cookie_relay_state["attempts"], 1)

    def test_controller_stop_or_pause_during_last_window_check_blocks_dispatch(self):
        for desired_state in ("stopped", "paused"):
            with self.subTest(desired_state=desired_state), tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as temporary:
                server, session, desktop, window, image, _proof, state = (
                    relay_tests.CookieRelayRuntimeTests.fixture(self, Path(temporary))
                )
                checks = [0]

                def window_check(_session):
                    checks[0] += 1
                    if checks[0] == 3:
                        state["desired_state"] = desired_state
                    return window

                server._verified_action_window.side_effect = window_check
                self.assertFalse(server._try_cookie_relay(session, window, image, relay_tests.time.monotonic()))
                self.assertEqual(checks[0], 3)
                self.assertFalse(desktop.clicks)
                self.assertEqual(session.cookie_relay_state["status"], "pending")
                self.assertEqual(session.cookie_relay_state["attempts"], 1)

from __future__ import annotations

import copy
import json
import sys
import tempfile
import unittest
from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / "scripts"))
import visionstudio_controller_state as controller


class RunProfilePresetTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self) -> None:
        self.temporary = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
        self.addCleanup(self.temporary.cleanup)
        self.path = Path(self.temporary.name) / "controller" / "state.json"

    def save(self, name: str = "ฟาร์ม EXP", seconds: int = 150, **kwargs: object) -> dict:
        return controller.save_run_profile_preset(
            self.path, name=name, expected_seconds=seconds, **kwargs
        )

    def test_legacy_state_without_presets_keeps_the_existing_plan(self) -> None:
        state = controller.default_state()
        state.pop("run_profile_presets")
        state.pop("selected_run_profile_preset_id")
        config, plan = controller.compile_universal_plan(state["universal_config"])
        state.update(universal_config=config, universal_plan=plan)
        controller.write_state(self.path, state)
        loaded = controller.read_state(self.path)
        self.assertEqual(loaded["run_profile_presets"], [])
        self.assertIsNone(loaded["selected_run_profile_preset_id"])
        self.assertEqual(loaded["universal_plan"], plan)
        self.assertEqual(loaded["universal_config"], config)

    def test_named_timing_is_durable_before_start_and_edit_keeps_its_id(self) -> None:
        saved = self.save("  ฟาร์ม   EXP  ", 150)
        preset_id = saved["selected_run_profile_preset_id"]
        self.assertEqual(saved["desired_state"], "idle")
        self.assertEqual(saved["run_profile"], {"mode": "auto", "expected_seconds": None})
        self.assertEqual(controller.read_state(self.path)["run_profile_presets"], [
            {"id": preset_id, "name": "ฟาร์ม EXP", "expected_seconds": 150}
        ])
        edited = self.save("เก็บเหรียญ", 240, preset_id=preset_id)
        self.assertEqual(edited["selected_run_profile_preset_id"], preset_id)
        self.assertEqual(edited["run_profile_presets"], [
            {"id": preset_id, "name": "เก็บเหรียญ", "expected_seconds": 240}
        ])
        self.assertEqual(controller.read_state(self.path)["run_profile_presets"], edited["run_profile_presets"])

    def test_duplicate_normalized_name_is_rejected_without_overwriting(self) -> None:
        self.save("Farm EXP")
        original = self.path.read_bytes()
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "already exists"):
            self.save("  fArM  exp  ", 270)
        self.assertEqual(self.path.read_bytes(), original)

    def test_unicode_equivalent_names_cannot_create_duplicate_rows(self) -> None:
        self.save("Café", 150)
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "already exists"):
            self.save("Cafe\u0301", 270)

    def test_invalid_names_and_times_leave_durable_state_unchanged(self) -> None:
        self.save()
        original = self.path.read_bytes()
        for name in ("", "   ", "x" * 49, "Farm\nEXP", "Farm\tEXP", "Farm\x00EXP", "Farm\u202eEXP", 123, None):
            with self.subTest(name=repr(name)), self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                self.save(name)
            self.assertEqual(self.path.read_bytes(), original)
        for seconds in (True, False, 0, 29, 1801, 150.0, 150.5, float("nan"), float("inf"), "150", None):
            with self.subTest(seconds=repr(seconds)), self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                self.save("Other", seconds)
            self.assertEqual(self.path.read_bytes(), original)

    def test_boundary_times_remain_existing_custom_profile_values(self) -> None:
        for seconds in (30, 1800):
            saved = self.save(f"Time {seconds}", seconds)
            row = saved["run_profile_presets"][-1]
            self.assertEqual(
                controller.normalize_run_profile({"mode": "custom", "expected_seconds": row["expected_seconds"]}),
                {"mode": "custom", "expected_seconds": seconds},
            )

    def test_unknown_edit_delete_and_select_do_not_create_or_replace_a_row(self) -> None:
        self.save()
        original = self.path.read_bytes()
        for operation in (
            lambda: self.save("Unknown", 240, preset_id="0" * 32),
            lambda: controller.delete_run_profile_preset(self.path, "0" * 32),
            lambda: controller.select_run_profile_preset(self.path, "0" * 32),
            lambda: controller.select_run_profile_preset(self.path, "../../state.json"),
        ):
            with self.subTest(operation=operation), self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                operation()
            self.assertEqual(self.path.read_bytes(), original)

    def test_deleting_selected_preset_preserves_time_and_does_not_pick_another(self) -> None:
        first = self.save("EXP", 150)["selected_run_profile_preset_id"]
        second = self.save("Coins", 240)["selected_run_profile_preset_id"]
        controller.select_run_profile_preset(self.path, first)
        state = controller.delete_run_profile_preset(self.path, first)
        self.assertIsNone(state["selected_run_profile_preset_id"])
        self.assertEqual([row["id"] for row in state["run_profile_presets"]], [second])
        self.assertEqual(state["run_profile"], {"mode": "auto", "expected_seconds": None})
        controller.select_run_profile_preset(self.path, second)
        self.assertIsNone(controller.select_run_profile_preset(self.path, None)["selected_run_profile_preset_id"])

    def test_repeated_selection_and_identical_save_do_not_invalidate_confirmations(self) -> None:
        state = self.save()
        original = self.path.read_bytes()
        controller.select_run_profile_preset(self.path, state["selected_run_profile_preset_id"])
        self.save(preset_id=state["selected_run_profile_preset_id"])
        self.assertEqual(self.path.read_bytes(), original)

    def test_damaged_optional_library_does_not_modify_active_run_authority(self) -> None:
        state = controller.request_start(
            self.path, mission_path=ROOT / "universal-loop", requested_loops=10,
            run_until=None, telegram_enabled=True,
            universal_config={"run_profile": {"mode": "custom", "expected_seconds": 150}, "cookie_relay": {"enabled": True}},
        )
        frozen = copy.deepcopy({key: state[key] for key in ("run_profile", "universal_config", "universal_plan", "batch_plan", "worker")})
        state["run_profile_presets"] = [
            {"id": "a" * 32, "name": "EXP", "expected_seconds": 150},
            {"id": "b" * 32, "name": "exp", "expected_seconds": 240},
            {"id": "a" * 32, "name": "Duplicate id", "expected_seconds": 180},
            {"id": "c" * 32, "name": "Broken time", "expected_seconds": True},
            {"id": "d" * 32, "name": "Broken\nname", "expected_seconds": 180},
            None,
        ]
        state["selected_run_profile_preset_id"] = "c" * 32
        controller.write_state(self.path, state)
        loaded = controller.read_state(self.path)
        self.assertEqual(loaded["run_profile_presets"], [{"id": "a" * 32, "name": "EXP", "expected_seconds": 150}])
        self.assertIsNone(loaded["selected_run_profile_preset_id"])
        self.assertEqual({key: loaded[key] for key in frozen}, frozen)
        self.assertEqual(loaded["desired_state"], "running")

    def test_saving_library_does_not_change_live_batch_or_recovery_fields(self) -> None:
        started = controller.request_start(
            self.path, mission_path=ROOT / "universal-loop", requested_loops=None,
            run_until=None, telegram_enabled=False,
            universal_config={"run_profile": {"mode": "short", "expected_seconds": 180}, "cookie_relay": {"enabled": True}},
        )
        keys = ("desired_state", "run_profile", "universal_config", "universal_plan", "batch_plan", "worker", "last_event")
        frozen = copy.deepcopy({key: started[key] for key in keys})
        saved = self.save("Next farming", 300)
        self.assertEqual({key: saved[key] for key in keys}, frozen)
        self.assertEqual(saved["universal_plan"]["revision"], "10")

    def test_library_survives_start_pause_resume_and_reset(self) -> None:
        saved = self.save()
        presets = saved["run_profile_presets"]
        selected = saved["selected_run_profile_preset_id"]
        controller.request_start(
            self.path, mission_path=ROOT / "universal-loop", requested_loops=10,
            run_until=None, telegram_enabled=True,
            run_profile={"mode": "custom", "expected_seconds": 150},
        )
        controller.request_pause_after_stage(self.path)
        controller.mark_paused(self.path, "passive-running")
        controller.request_resume(self.path)
        controller.mark_stopped(self.path, "stop preserves preset preferences")
        state = controller.reset_state(self.path)
        self.assertEqual(state["run_profile_presets"], presets)
        self.assertEqual(state["selected_run_profile_preset_id"], selected)
        self.assertIsNone(state["batch_plan"])
        self.assertEqual(state["desired_state"], "idle")
        self.assertEqual(controller.read_state(self.path)["run_profile_presets"], presets)

    def test_future_state_schema_cannot_be_overwritten_by_preset_save(self) -> None:
        self.path.parent.mkdir(parents=True)
        raw = json.dumps({"schema_version": controller.SCHEMA_VERSION + 1, "private_future_field": "preserve"}).encode()
        self.path.write_bytes(raw)
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "future"):
            self.save()
        self.assertEqual(self.path.read_bytes(), raw)

    def test_library_limit_allows_existing_edit_but_rejects_new_preset(self) -> None:
        for index in range(controller.RUN_PROFILE_PRESET_MAX_COUNT):
            self.save(f"Farm {index}")
        before = self.path.read_bytes()
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "up to 50"):
            self.save("Too many")
        self.assertEqual(self.path.read_bytes(), before)
        first = controller.read_state(self.path)["run_profile_presets"][0]["id"]
        edited = self.save("Updated", 240, preset_id=first)
        self.assertEqual(len(edited["run_profile_presets"]), controller.RUN_PROFILE_PRESET_MAX_COUNT)
        self.assertEqual(edited["run_profile_presets"][0]["name"], "Updated")

    def test_concurrent_heartbeat_and_saves_keep_both_sets_of_changes(self) -> None:
        controller.write_state(self.path, controller.default_state())

        def heartbeat() -> None:
            for index in range(25):
                controller.patch_state(self.path, worker={"message": f"heartbeat {index}"})

        def preferences() -> None:
            for index in range(25):
                self.save(f"Farm {index}", 100 + index)

        with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=2) as pool:
            futures = [pool.submit(heartbeat), pool.submit(preferences)]
            for future in futures:
                future.result()
        state = controller.read_state(self.path)
        self.assertEqual(state["worker"]["message"], "heartbeat 24")
        self.assertEqual(len(state["run_profile_presets"]), 25)
        self.assertEqual(state["revision"], 51)
